message: `2>/dev/null` hides this command's error messages and its failure is not otherwise handled; drop the redirect or test the status with `||`
help: drop the `2>/dev/null` so the error shows, or test the status: `cmd 2>/dev/null || echo 'cmd failed' >&2`
notes: 2>/dev/null appears in 21% of measured agent shell calls and hides the error the next step needs
